query:
The family operates with an understanding that when Nkechi cooks for a gathering, everyone eats what she has prepared without requesting alternatives. Does this expectation apply to all family members equally? If not, who behaves differently, and what makes this visible without it becoming a conflict?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Tobenna
C. Ifeoma
D. Chisom
context:
[1] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:11:00) My children. I will make egusi with stockfish. Ifeoma, I have remembered every year but it is good that you mentioned it. The menu is settled then: ofe onugbu, jollof, egusi with stockfish. Kingsley handles his suya outside. Adaeze brings chin chin and puff puff. 🙏
[2] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:49:00) My children. Kingsley the kitchen in this house is not a barbecue pit. But I will allow the suya if you keep the smoke outside. Adaeze, chin chin is expected, do not arrive without it. God willing, I have a full house this year. Oby, are you joining us from Enugu via video? 🙏
[3] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:29:00) okay so on it. I'll put together a running order: 1. Video call with Aunty Oby at 11am before food 2. Food from 2pm 3. Emeka's lot arriving by 12 based on his message. (no stress, I'll circulate it by Friday!) 😊
[4] (about=Chisom, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:09:00) Ifeoma I totally forgot!! okay SO Mum can you do a small pot of egusi with stockfish? that would sort Ifeoma and honestly I would also eat that 😭
[5] (about=Kingsley, said_by=Nkechi, profile, t8 @2025-11-16T16:22:00) Nkechi takes back her previous criticism of Kingsley and acknowledges his booking of the venue.
[6] (about=Nkechi, core, t13 @2025-12-07T17:33:00) Nkechi needs answers by Wednesday to plan the Christmas meal.
[7] (about=Nkechi, core, t13 @2025-12-07T17:33:00) Nkechi is asking for a headcount of attendees to determine the amount of food to prepare.
[8] (about=Nkechi, core, t13 @2025-12-07T17:33:00) Nkechi is the parent organizing the Christmas gathering.
[9] (about=Nkechi, core, t13 @2025-12-07T17:33:00) Nkechi is preparing for the Christmas gathering in Reading.
[10] (about=Nkechi, core, t13 @2025-12-07T17:33:00) Nkechi is using the phrase 'ofe onugbu' and 'jollof', which are Nigerian dishes.
[11] (about=Nkechi, core, t13 @2025-12-07T17:33:00) Nkechi is preparing for Christmas and needs a headcount of attendees by Wednesday.
[12] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:22:00) I will transfer mine on Wednesday from Enugu. Adaeze, you do this every year. I have said before that Nkechi or Emeka should share this responsibility with you. You should not be chasing grown people for money alone.
